programs.title: Rise and Shine, Benedict Stone

programs.title: Fashionably Yours

programs.title: Second Honeymoon
programs.desc: The children of a couple (Roma Downey, Tim Matheson) on the brink of divorce send their parents on a trip in hopes of rekindling the romance.

programs.title: Love by Chance
programs.desc: Claire, the owner of a new restaurant, is too busy to focus on relationships. Her mother decides to fix this by finding Claire the perfect man -- without telling Claire.

programs.title: Two Turtle Doves
programs.desc: Dr. Sharon Hayes returns home to search for a beloved family heirloom. With the help of an adorable little girl and her dispirited father, together they rediscover the magic of Christmas.
